summary:
Adapting Farms with NASA Data
This project uses NASA satellite data and weather information to help farmers make better agricultural decisions. It monitors rainfall, temperature, soil moisture and crop health to provide crop recommendations, irrigation guidance and climate alerts. The main goal is to improve farming productivity, conserve water and help farmers adapt to climate change.
details:
Project Title: Adapting Farms with NASA Data

Project Domain: Agriculture, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics and Remote Sensing.

1. Project Overview

This project uses NASA satellite data and weather information to help farmers understand environmental conditions and make better farming decisions. It analyzes rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, vegetation health and climate patterns to support sustainable agriculture.

2. Main Objectives

  • Monitor weather and climate conditions.
  • Analyze soil moisture and vegetation health.
  • Identify drought and flood risks.
  • Recommend suitable crops based on environmental conditions.
  • Suggest efficient irrigation methods.
  • Improve agricultural productivity and reduce crop losses.

3. Technologies Used

  • Programming: Python
  • Data Analysis: Pandas, NumPy
  • Machine Learning: Scikit-learn
  • Visualization: Matplotlib, Power BI
  • Satellite Data: NASA POWER, NASA Earth data
  • Maps: GIS and satellite imagery

4. Key Modules

  1. Weather Monitoring: Tracks temperature, rainfall and humidity.
  2. Soil Analysis: Studies soil moisture conditions.
  3. Crop Recommendation: Suggests suitable crops using environmental data.
  4. Climate Risk Prediction: Identifies drought and extreme weather risks.
  5. Data Visualization: Displays agricultural insights through graphs and dashboards.

5. Expected Outcomes

  • Better crop selection.
  • Improved water management.
  • Reduced climate-related crop losses.
  • Increased awareness of weather conditions.
  • Sustainable farming practices.

6. Project Applications

  • Smart agriculture
  • Precision farming
  • Climate-resilient farming
  • Agricultural planning
  • Government agricultural support programs
